question: Does the selected atomic closed-loop measurement source instantiate a causal physical clock-W instrument for unchanged PAH-v2?
finding: No complete bridge is supplied by the inspected source pair. The atomic protocol is not an identified PAH probe. Missing physical input is represented once as a joint instrument, not as multiple new proof chains. This is a bounded applicability audit, not a universal absence claim or a new PAH no-go.

source_facts.DAS_II: Equations (1)-(2) describe adiabatic dark-state holonomy on control parameters; the final paragraph separates traversal rate from the geometric path.
source_facts.DAS_III: A four-state Schroedinger interaction and characteristic Rabi frequency supply apparatus dynamics and units. The stated closed bare phases sum to an integer multiple of 2*pi.
source_facts.DAS_VIII: Equation (20) and following text reconstruct matrix entries using complex bare-state amplitudes in forward/reverse protocols.
source_facts.DAS_IX: Equations (27)-(29) propose atomic couplings with RWA, detuning, frequency, intensity and phase restrictions. They are not a PAH calibration dataset.
source_facts.exclusions: No non-Abelian mixed-density-matrix or loop-order theorem from this source is imported; no full-paper correctness certification is asserted.

source_crosswalk.assessment: PAH's neutral kappa0*s_v^nu tagged walk has no declared coherent U-sensitive amplitude coupling. A material Hamiltonian driving laser-controlled parameters does not identify the PAH link field.

Complex synthetic loop data are not the unweighted mean of scalar PAH face holonomies. A reference-arm conditional reconstruction is written only in the separate unadopted proposal. Equal averaging and per-face calibration must be preserved.
An external clock and Rabi scale define apparatus time, not t_r from seconds to PAH time. No synchronized global W acquisition, clock covariance or independent kinetic calibration is supplied.

The experiment has finite exposure and controlled quantum evolution. No original-Gibbs background marginal or quantified disturbance/quasistatic error is supplied. Posterior conditioning and physical disturbance must be separated.

No mapping keeps the physical apparatus, equal-face region, duration and error law fixed across PAH r. A hardware encoding of sampled configurations is not an identification of natural microscopic variables.
No PAH response calibration, complete covariance or controlled exposure/nonadiabatic/dynamic-phase bound is supplied. Source feasibility is not measured calibration.
No independent unused PAH outcomes, frozen scorer or predicted distribution are present. No retrospective example or engineered match receives empirical credit.

hypothesis_checks.finding: Keep scalar Re U, stored orientation and equal-face mean. Do not replace with U(2) trace, its modulus or J_p(s)-weighted energy.
DAS dark-state quantum amplitude space is not PAH full integer counting state; no map or probe coupling identifies them.
Adiabatic control traversal is not PAH cutoff refinement or a physical time conversion; R-576 only has fixed h,N,epsilon>0 and r->infinity.

Equating the source's closed four bare control phases directly to every PAH face link would restrict their product to one. General PAH face configurations are not so restricted. This is a mismatch of that naive shortcut, not an impossibility theorem for an indirect instrument.
